name: NiLoNs
ingredients_raw: Water, garlic, ginger, refined sunflower oil, iodised salt, spices and condiments, sugar, corn starch, flavour enhancer (INS 635), acidity regulator (INS 260) and preservatives (INS 211, INS 202). Contains permitted natural colour (INS 160c(i), INS 150c) and added flavour (artificial flavour substance celery).
